title: XP Trying To Get Back Into RMXP But I Am At A Complete Loss On Mapping Anymore

posts.author: Aceri
posts.body:
Like the title states, I decided to get back into RMXP after having not touched ANY RPG Maker program since MZ released and the mapping for XP is so foreign to me. I've tried looking at guides/tutorials on youtube but all that comes up, at least when I search, are guides for setting up either fancy tech on parallax maps or how to map routes for Pokemon fan games. Is there some place with like a written guide or resources where I can just browse RMXP maps from other people to kinda pick the eye back up for how the engine works again?
Thanks in advanced all.

posts.author: TeiRaven
posts.body:
I did a
written guide for mapping in RMXP
! It's part of my
Intro to RMXP
series, which I really should get back to one of these days.
When you've gotten your feet under you with the tools again,
Avery
also has a huge amount of really spectacular mapping tutorials for MZ. The technical bits will be different (MZ uses way more autotiles) but the concepts and techniques very much still apply in XP!
I wish I had a suggestion for where to go to browse specifically-XP screenshots, but alas. Maybe try looking in the Completed/In Progress forums for games that are tagged RMXP, and look at the screenshots in those?
